about: Window reads of a qualified field, which check refuses from the declarations exactly as build does (WINDOW-11, NAME-3, NAME-4). A column-level window spans the rows of every row template and reads a qualified field at the record that built each row. When the row templates do not all share one driver, a read of a field of one of their drivers, or of the input a named intermediate driver reads, names no record of the other templates' rows: each operand of every window operation (rank, row_number's group and order terms and filter, row_value, locf, each baseline_flag operand), a named window where it is used and a window in a case result is refused as unknown_field, naming the field, each driver once in construction order and the window operation; grouping either template refuses it the same way, and the rows a named intermediate builds are its own, not those of the input it reads. Over row templates that share the driver the window builds: ties keep row-template order, then record order. A grouped template over the shared driver still reads only its group keys (NAME-4), and a read of a dataset whose records build none of the rows is refused in any window (NAME-3): the operands first, then each name of the filter once, in sorted order. A row template's own window reads its driver's records, and without row templates the base driver builds every row. spec is a window over subjects rows built from DM and events rows built from AE, ordered by DM.AGE; base is one without row templates. S1 is 40, S2 30 and S3 50; S1 has three adverse events, two of them serious, and S2 one serious event; LB builds no row. negative-window-other-driver pins a refusal's first issue, sdtm-fa-reactogenicity-diary a window over templates that share the driver; no benchmark pins the rest. Moved from execution_column_window_drivers.rs at 144fc5559, whose tests compared every issue of check and build through the five fields of study::issue_row, and for each build that saved, a clean check, a clean build and the saved out.csv.
